{{Quote|&hellip; Hers was a tale of ancient lineage.<br />"A story older than the suns.<br />"Hers was the tale of the Empire's hired gun who comes to dine with blood soaked hands and frosted smile like honey wine, transfixing like the serpent before it strikes with equal compassion&hellip;|An excerpt from Thalos Lorin's play ''Serpent's Rain''|<ref name="GG10" />}}
'''''Serpent Rain''''' was a drama that the playwright [[Thalos Lorin]] was best known for.

==Behind the scenes==
''Serpent Rain'' was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', and was later referenced in the online game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', in a question that the [[Unidentified Theed Palace librarian|Theed Palace librarian]] can ask player characters.
